description: Lowercased region folder name (canonical grouping key). One of the 8 BPAC regions.
Region folder name as stored on disk (original casing, e.g. `Faridpur`).
`male` or `female`, parsed from the speaker folder name.
`lab` or `app` -- the recording pipeline. Perfectly confounded with gender by recruitment design (lab=male, app=female); never treat as separable. See invariant 3 in the BPAC Paper 1 spec.
Numeric id from the speaker folder name (not globally unique on its own -- combine with region).
Speaker's name/handle from the speaker folder name.
NFC-normalized sentence text, joined from `best_diverse_sentences.csv` by `sentence_id`.
Raw clip duration in seconds (header probe, no full decode). Only present when `probe_durations=True`.
Sample rate of the *raw* (pre-normalization) file, so format provenance survives normalization. Only present when `probe_format=True`.
Channel count of the raw file. Only present when `probe_format=True`.
